incident.name: 2015 Chennai Floods
incident.summary: Exceptional north-east monsoon rainfall over Chennai and northern Tamil Nadu in November-December 2015, culminating in the 1-2 December deluge and widespread urban inundation along the Adyar and Cooum rivers.

provenance.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, ~0.25 degree grid)
provenance.note: ERA5 is a gridded reanalysis, not a rain-gauge record. Reanalysis grids smooth local convective extremes, so the ERA5 grid-cell rainfall for 1-2 December 2015 is far lower than the documented station totals listed under documentedFacts. Values are used exactly as returned; nothing is scaled or filled.

variables.label: Rainfall accumulation
variables.source: Summed from ERA5 hourly precipitation (trailing 6 h / 24 h)

variables.label: Precipitation probability
variables.source: Probabilistic forecasts do not exist in a reanalysis archive

documentedFacts.label: 24 h rainfall ending 08:30 IST, 2 Dec 2015
documentedFacts.source: IMD figures as reported by Frontline / The Hindu

documentedFacts.label: November 2015 monthly rainfall, Chennai (Nungambakkam)
documentedFacts.value: approx. 1,049 mm - wettest November in over a century

documentedFacts.label: Chembarambakkam reservoir discharge, night of 1 Dec 2015
documentedFacts.value: approx. 29,400 cusecs released into the Adyar river

documentedFacts.label: Chennai International Airport
documentedFacts.value: Operations suspended 1 Dec 2015 after runway and apron inundation; closed for several days

documentedFacts.label: Reported inundation
documentedFacts.value: Kotturpuram, Saidapet, Velachery, Tambaram, Mudichur and other low-lying areas flooded; road, rail and telecom disruption

replay.note: Daily steps across the event window; 3-hourly steps across the documented 1-2 December 2015 peak.
